targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='success') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'response'->>'attempt')::int > 1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'response'->>'duration_ms')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'duration_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT data AS "Endpoint", count(*) AS "Запросов", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='success') AS "OK", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='failed') AS "Fail", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (payload->'response'->>'attempt')::int > 1) AS "Retries", avg((payload->'response'->>'duration_ms')::int)::int AS "Avg ms", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'response'->>'duration_ms')::int)::int AS "p95 ms" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(payload->'response'->>'status_code', 'NULL') AS "Code", count(*) AS "Запросов" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '15m') AS time, data AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'response'->>'duration_ms')::int) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND status='success' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", data AS "Endpoint", payload->'response'->>'status_code' AS "Code", payload->'response'->>'attempt' AS "Attempt", payload->'response'->>'duration_ms' AS "ms", payload->'response'->>'error' AS "Ошибка" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='http.request.sent' AND status='failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;
